findings.evidence: Line 201: `theorem range_weightTorusPoints_eq_diagonalPoints (K : Type u) [CommRing K]` vs. line 192 `centralizer_range_weightTorusPoints (K : Type u) [Field K] [Infinite K]`.
findings.fix: Split the claim: the weight torus equals the diagonal carrier points over any commutative ring; only the centralizer computation and maximality need an infinite field (or `IsCancelMulZero` plus injective weight characters). Retitle the section accordingly.
findings.issue: Module docstring says "Over an infinite field, the standard carrier's weight-torus points are precisely the determinant-one diagonal matrices", and bullet line 22 repeats that framing, but `range_weightTorusPoints_eq_diagonalPoints` (line 201) assumes only `[CommRing K]`. The section header at line 130, "The centralizer on field-valued points", likewise sits above ring-level material (`diagonalPoints`, `mem_diagonalPoints_iff`, `range_weightTorusPoints_eq_diagonalPoints`).

findings.evidence: Lines 148-149 and 193-194 both conclude `Subgroup.centralizer ((weightTorusPoints r K).range : Set (points r K)) = diagonalPoints r K`.
findings.fix: State the equality in both docstrings: the centralizer of the weight torus in the carrier points is exactly the diagonal subgroup.
findings.issue: Docstring reads "a carrier point centralizing the weight torus is diagonal", but the statement is `Subgroup.centralizer (range) = diagonalPoints`, i.e. also that every diagonal carrier point centralizes the torus. Same mismatch at lines 143-144 for `centralizer_range_weightTorusPoints_of_weightChar_injective`.

findings.evidence: Lines 87-89 declare the lemma with no preceding `/-- -/`; lines 38 and 49 show the file's convention of documenting private helpers.
findings.fix: Add a one-line docstring: on a determinant-one diagonal point `t`, the torus point given by the partial products `Fin.partialProd t` has weight-character values `t k`, so it is the inverse of the weight parametrization.
findings.issue: `torusCharacter_partialProd` has no docstring, although it carries the non-obvious content of the file (partial products of the diagonal entries invert the weight parametrization, using `∏ i, t i = 1`); the two neighbouring private lemmas at lines 38 and 49 are documented.

summary: The module docstring attributes the diagonal-identification theorem to "over an infinite field" although it holds over any commutative ring, and the two centralizer theorems are stated as subgroup equalities but documented as a single inclusion. One private lemma carrying the inverse construction is undocumented while its siblings are documented.
